views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.StudentID,
  s.StudLastName,
  ss.ClassID,
  ss.ClassStatus,
  ss.Grade,
  c.SubjectID,
  subj.SubjectName,
  subj.CategoryID
FROM
  Student_Schedules AS ss
JOIN
  Students AS s ON ss.StudentID = s.StudentID
JOIN
  Classes AS c ON ss.ClassID = c.ClassID
JOIN
  Subjects AS subj ON c.SubjectID = subj.SubjectID
WHERE
  ss.ClassStatus = 2
  AND subj.SubjectName LIKE '%English%'
views.description: Task: Produce a list of last names for every student who has completed English courses (completion defined as ClassStatus = 2) along with a quintile label determined by each student's rank among all s
